title: A Study to Assess the Cholesterol Lowering Effect of Ezetimibe/Simvastatin Combination Tablet Compared to Another Cholesterol Lowering Drug in Elderly Patients With High Cholesterol at High or Moderately High Risk for Coronary Heart Disease (0653A-128)

sections.abstract:
A multicenter study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of ezetimibe/simvastatin versus atorvastatin in elderly patients with high cholesterol at high or moderately high risk for coronary heart disease.

Posted outcomes: Percent Change From Baseline in Low Density Lipoprotein (LDL-C) at Week 12. timeframe=Baseline and 12 weeks. Atorvastatin 10 mg=-39.5; Ezetimibe 10 mg/Simvastatin 20 mg=-54.2; Atorvastatin 20 mg=-46.6. p=<0.001
